changes: Updated docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md so documentation and decision-doc audits follow the same ordinary REVIEW default and automatic first-round threshold escalation policy as code changes. The document now treats current direct decision-doc 3x2 behavior as legacy transitional runtime behavior, not the target policy, and preserves explicit degraded 3x1 lower-assurance fallback rules.
usage: Use this decision document as the implementation plan for the follow-up runtime story: documentation audits default to normal REVIEW, escalate to full 3x2 only when the first REVIEW round records at least two countable problems, and may use approved degraded 3x1 when the second host is unavailable or explicitly approved single-host local mode is allowed.
expectedOutcome: The user should see that documentation audit is no longer planned as permanent always-on decision-doc 3x2. The visible plan should state ordinary REVIEW first, threshold-triggered 3x2, approved degraded 3x1 fallback, and an honest current-runtime legacy transition note.
actualTranscript: Manual policy assertion printed: doc policy and English-only checks passed. lattice validate --story=B-b663 --json returned status pass, allPass true, verification intent coverage 6/6, and npm test passed with ALL PASS. REVIEW lanes concept, quality, test-coverage, and docs all passed with zero findings. Delivery reviewer wrote delivery-check.json and confirmed delivery-check PASS.
outcomeDiff: No user-value difference: the document now matches the requested policy. Runtime implementation is intentionally not changed in this documentation-only story and remains a follow-up implementation task.
limitations: Runtime gate behavior was not changed in this story. The document explicitly says current implementation may still enforce legacy direct decision-doc 3x2 until a follow-up implementation story migrates the gate.
